title: OutreachFollowupInput
description: Input for generating a B2B publisher outreach follow-up email.

publisher_domain.description: The publisher's website domain, e.g. 'media.com' or 'news.net'.

step.description: The sequence step. 'day_3' = second touch, 'day_7' = final brief attempt with referral request.

previous_email_sent.description: Full text of the initial cold outreach email that was sent to the publisher.
